advisories.reason: No published fix (<=3.0.3 all vulnerable, latest is 3.0.3). Reached only through tailwindcss build-time tooling (chokidar/micromatch) — never parses untrusted glob input at runtime. Revisit when a patched braces ships.

Transitive via get-uri/proxy-agent inside @puppeteer/browsers. The FTP code path only executes when a proxy chain requests an ftp:// URI — our deployment never configures one. No fixed version in range for get-uri@6.

Transitive via @puppeteer/browsers. Runs only at browser-download time on zip archives fetched from Chrome release endpoints, not on user-supplied archives. extract-zip has no fixed release; upstream moved @puppeteer/browsers to modern-tar in 3.x which @cloudflare/puppeteer has not adopted.
Same reachability as GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv — install-time extraction of trusted Chrome archives only.
Transitive via tailwindcss/postcss-nested — build-time CSS compilation of our own stylesheet only, never parses attacker input. postcss-nested pins ^6.1.1 with no release accepting 7.1.6.
